#---------------------------------------------------------#
1. Microbiota_Behavior_correlation_Faceted_Volcano_By_Level
#---------------------------------------------------------#
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)

# ==============================
# Output folder
# ==============================

outdir <- "Microbiota_Behavior_Faceted_Volcano_By_Level"
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ==============================
# Load data
# ==============================

df <- read_excel("Spearman correlation_microbiota_behaviour.xlsx")


# ==============================
# Rename exposure groups
# ==============================

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    SampleType = recode(
      as.character(SampleType),
      "Control" = "CON",
      "PAE"     = "ALC",
      "CBD"     = "CB",
      "SAC"     = "ALC+CB"
    ),
    SampleType = factor(
      SampleType,
      levels = c("CON", "ALC", "CB", "ALC+CB")
    )
  )

# Verify group labels and sample numbers
table(df$SampleType, useNA = "ifany")


# ==============================
# Behaviors
# ==============================

behaviors <- c(
  "Time on rotarod",
  "Time in center_Open field",
  "Distance_travelled"
)

behavior_titles <- c(
  "Time on rotarod" = "Time on rotarod",
  "Time in center_Open field" = "Time in center_Open field",
  "Distance_travelled" = "Distance travelled"
)

# ==============================
# Taxonomic levels
# ==============================

tax_levels <- list(
  Phylum  = "^p__",
  Family  = "^f__",
  Genus   = "^g__",
  Species = "^s__"
)

prevalence_cutoff <- 0.40

# ==============================
# Function to run correlations
# ==============================

run_level_correlation <- function(df, level_name, taxa_pattern){

  taxa <- grep(taxa_pattern, colnames(df), value = TRUE)

  if(length(taxa) == 0){
    return(NULL)
  }

  df_level <- df %>%
    mutate(across(
      all_of(c(taxa, behaviors)),
      ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.)))
    ))

  present_fraction <- colMeans(df_level[taxa] > 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  taxa_filtered <- names(
    present_fraction[present_fraction >= prevalence_cutoff]
  )

  if(length(taxa_filtered) == 0){
    return(NULL)
  }

  corr_results <- data.frame()

  for(t in taxa_filtered){

    for(b in behaviors){

      temp_df <- df_level %>%
        mutate(
          Taxa_value = .data[[t]],
          Behavior_value = .data[[b]]
        ) %>%
        filter(
          !is.na(Taxa_value),
          !is.na(Behavior_value)
        )

      if(
        nrow(temp_df) >= 4 &&
        length(unique(temp_df$Taxa_value)) > 1 &&
        length(unique(temp_df$Behavior_value)) > 1
      ){

        test <- suppressWarnings(
          cor.test(
            temp_df$Taxa_value,
            temp_df$Behavior_value,
            method = "spearman",
            exact = FALSE
          )
        )

        corr_results <- rbind(
          corr_results,
          data.frame(
            Level = level_name,
            Taxa = t,
            Behavior = b,
            Rho = unname(test$estimate),
            Pvalue = test$p.value,
            N = nrow(temp_df)
          )
        )
      }
    }
  }

  if(nrow(corr_results) == 0){
    return(NULL)
  }

  corr_results <- corr_results %>%
  group_by(Behavior) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(Pvalue, method = "BH"),
    neglog10P = -log10(Pvalue),
    Abs_Rho = abs(Rho),

    Sig_Category = case_when(
      Pvalue < 0.05 & Rho > 0 ~ "Positive significant",
      Pvalue < 0.05 & Rho < 0 ~ "Negative significant",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),

    Taxa_clean = Taxa %>%
      str_replace("^[pfgs]__", "") %>%
      str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
      str_replace_all("'", ""),

    Behavior_clean = as.character(behavior_titles[Behavior]),

    Plot_Label = case_when(
      Level %in% c("Genus", "Species") ~
        paste0("italic('", Taxa_clean, "')"),

      TRUE ~
        paste0("'", Taxa_clean, "'")
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Pvalue)

  return(corr_results)
}

# ==============================
# Run all levels
# ==============================

all_results <- list()

for(level_name in names(tax_levels)){

  message("Running: ", level_name)

  res <- run_level_correlation(
    df = df,
    level_name = level_name,
    taxa_pattern = tax_levels[[level_name]]
  )

  if(!is.null(res)){
    all_results[[level_name]] <- res
  }
}

all_results_df <- bind_rows(all_results)

if(nrow(all_results_df) == 0){
  stop("No correlation results were generated. Check input columns or prevalence cutoff.")
}

write.csv(
  all_results_df,
  file.path(outdir, "All_Levels_Spearman_Correlation_Results.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# ==============================
# Fixed axes
# ==============================

x_limits <- c(
  floor(min(all_results_df$Rho[is.finite(all_results_df$Rho)], na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10,
  ceiling(max(all_results_df$Rho[is.finite(all_results_df$Rho)], na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10
)

y_limits <- c(0, 5)
y_breaks <- c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)

# ==============================
# Faceted volcano for each taxonomic level
# ==============================

for(level_name in unique(all_results_df$Level)){

  plot_df <- all_results_df %>%
    filter(Level == level_name)

  label_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(Pvalue < 0.05)

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = Rho,
      y = neglog10P
    )
  ) +
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = -Inf,
      xmax = Inf,
      ymin = -log10(0.05),
      ymax = Inf,
      fill = "#FDE0DD",
      alpha = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        color = Sig_Category,
        size = Abs_Rho
      ),
      alpha = 0.90
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = Plot_Label),
      parse = TRUE,
      size = 5.2,
      fontface = "plain",
      max.overlaps = 10,
      box.padding = 0.7,
      point.padding = 0.4,
      segment.color = "grey40",
      segment.size = 0.4,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ Behavior_clean,
      nrow = 1
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = x_limits,
      ylim = y_limits
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = y_breaks
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Positive significant" = "#D73027",
        "Negative significant" = "#4575B4",
        "Other" = "grey70"
      )
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      range = c(2.5, 7)
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "grey95",
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.8
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 20,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 28
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(
        color = "black",
        size = 20
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(
        linewidth = 0.9,
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.ticks = element_line(
        linewidth = 0.8,
        color = "black"
      ),
      legend.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 20
      ),
      legend.text = element_text(
        size = 18
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 28,
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 16,
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      panel.spacing = unit(2.0, "lines"),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
    ) +
    guides(
      size = guide_legend(order = 2),
      color = guide_legend(
        order = 1,
        override.aes = list(size = 5)
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(level_name, "-level microbiota–behavior correlations"),
      subtitle = "Spearman correlations using microbial relative abundance",
      x = "Spearman rho",
      y = expression(-log[10](italic(p))),
      color = "Association",
      size = expression("|" * rho * "|")
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      outdir,
      paste0(level_name, "_Faceted_Behavior_Spearman_Volcano.pdf")
    ),
    p,
    width = 16,
    height = 8
  )
}
```

##ADDITIONAL GENUS LEVEL SCATTERPLOTS
```{r genus-significant-scatterplots-log10scale-clean, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

genus_scatter_dir <- file.path(outdir, "Genus_Significant_Scatterplots_Log10Scale")
dir.create(genus_scatter_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

genus_sig <- all_results_df %>%
  filter(Level == "Genus", Pvalue < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(Pvalue)

write.csv(
  genus_sig,
  file.path(genus_scatter_dir, "Genus_Significant_Hits_For_Scatterplots.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

if(nrow(genus_sig) == 0){
  stop("No significant genus-level hits found.")
}

pseudocount <- 1e-6

group_colors <- c(
  "CON" = "#7CAE00",
  "ALC" = "#00BFC4",
  "CB" = "#F8766D",
  "ALC+CB" = "#C77CFF"
)

make_genus_scatter <- function(data, taxa_name, behavior_name){

  taxa_clean <- taxa_name %>%
    str_replace("^g__", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("_", " ")

  behavior_clean <- behavior_titles[[behavior_name]]
  if(is.null(behavior_clean)){
    behavior_clean <- behavior_name
  }

  plot_df <- data %>%
    mutate(
      Taxa_value = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(as.character(.data[[taxa_name]]))
      ) + pseudocount,

      Behavior_value = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(as.character(.data[[behavior_name]]))
      ),

      SampleType = factor(
  SampleType,
  levels = c("CON", "ALC", "CB", "ALC+CB")
)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Taxa_value),
      !is.na(Behavior_value),
      Taxa_value > 0,
      !is.na(SampleType)
    )

  overall_cor <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(
      plot_df$Taxa_value,
      plot_df$Behavior_value,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )

  group_stats <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(SampleType) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      rho = ifelse(
        n >= 4 &&
          length(unique(Taxa_value)) > 1 &&
          length(unique(Behavior_value)) > 1,
        suppressWarnings(cor.test(
          Taxa_value,
          Behavior_value,
          method = "spearman",
          exact = FALSE
        )$estimate),
        NA
      ),
      p = ifelse(
        n >= 4 &&
          length(unique(Taxa_value)) > 1 &&
          length(unique(Behavior_value)) > 1,
        suppressWarnings(cor.test(
          Taxa_value,
          Behavior_value,
          method = "spearman",
          exact = FALSE
        )$p.value),
        NA
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      rho = round(rho, 2),
      p_text = case_when(
        is.na(p) ~ "NA",
        p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
        TRUE ~ as.character(signif(p, 2))
      ),
      label_text = paste0(SampleType, ": rho=", rho, ", p=", p_text)
    )

  overall_p_text <- case_when(
    overall_cor$p.value < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    TRUE ~ as.character(signif(overall_cor$p.value, 2))
  )

  subtitle_text <- paste0(
    "Overall: rho=",
    round(unname(overall_cor$estimate), 2),
    ", p=",
    overall_p_text
  )

  caption_text <- paste(group_stats$label_text, collapse = "   |   ")

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Taxa_value, y = Behavior_value)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = SampleType),
      size = 4,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      color = "black",
      fill = "grey80",
      se = TRUE,
      linewidth = 1.1
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      aes(color = SampleType),
      method = "lm",
      se = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.9,
      linetype = "dotted"
    ) +
    scale_x_log10(
      labels = label_scientific(),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.10))
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 20),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.9, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "plain", size = 24, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 15, r = 15, b = 35, l = 35)
    ) +
    labs(
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      caption = caption_text,
      x = bquote(
        atop(italic(.(taxa_clean)), "relative abundance (log10 scale)")
      ),
      y = behavior_clean
    ) +
    ggtitle(
      bquote(italic(.(taxa_clean)) ~ "vs" ~ .(as.character(behavior_clean)))
    )

  return(p)
}

genus_plots <- list()

for(i in seq_len(nrow(genus_sig))){

  taxa_i <- genus_sig$Taxa[i]
  behavior_i <- genus_sig$Behavior[i]

  p_i <- make_genus_scatter(df, taxa_i, behavior_i)

  genus_plots[[i]] <- p_i
  print(p_i)

  safe_taxa <- taxa_i %>%
    str_replace("^g__", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_")

  safe_behavior <- behavior_titles[[behavior_i]]
  if(is.null(safe_behavior)){
    safe_behavior <- behavior_i
  }

  safe_behavior <- safe_behavior %>%
    str_replace_all(" ", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "")

  ggsave(
    file.path(genus_scatter_dir, paste0("Scatter_", safe_taxa, "_", safe_behavior, ".pdf")),
    p_i,
    width = 14,
    height = 8
  )
}

if(length(genus_plots) > 0){

  combined_genus <- ggarrange(
    plotlist = genus_plots,
    ncol = 2,
    nrow = ceiling(length(genus_plots) / 2),
    common.legend = TRUE,
    legend = "right"
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(genus_scatter_dir, "Combined_Genus_Significant_Scatterplots.pdf"),
    combined_genus,
    width = 28,
    height = ceiling(length(genus_plots) / 2) * 10
  )
}
```

```{r species-significant-scatterplots-log10scale-clean, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  "CON" = "#7CAE00",

  "CB" = "#F8766D",

make_species_scatter <- function(data, taxa_name, behavior_name){

  taxa_clean <- taxa_name %>%
    str_replace("^s__", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("_", " ")

  behavior_clean <- behavior_titles[[behavior_name]]
  if(is.null(behavior_clean)){
    behavior_clean <- behavior_name
  }

  plot_df <- data %>%
    mutate(
      Taxa_value = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(as.character(.data[[taxa_name]]))
      ) + pseudocount,

      Behavior_value = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(as.character(.data[[behavior_name]]))
      ),

      SampleType = factor(
  SampleType,
  levels = c("CON", "ALC", "CB", "ALC+CB")
)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Taxa_value),
      !is.na(Behavior_value),
      Taxa_value > 0,
      !is.na(SampleType)
    )

  overall_cor <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(
      plot_df$Taxa_value,
      plot_df$Behavior_value,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )

  group_stats <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(SampleType) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      rho = ifelse(
        n >= 4 &&
          length(unique(Taxa_value)) > 1 &&
          length(unique(Behavior_value)) > 1,
        suppressWarnings(cor.test(
          Taxa_value,
          Behavior_value,
          method = "spearman",
          exact = FALSE
        )$estimate),
        NA
      ),
      p = ifelse(
        n >= 4 &&
          length(unique(Taxa_value)) > 1 &&
          length(unique(Behavior_value)) > 1,
        suppressWarnings(cor.test(
          Taxa_value,
          Behavior_value,
          method = "spearman",
          exact = FALSE
        )$p.value),
        NA
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      rho = round(rho, 2),
      p_text = case_when(
        is.na(p) ~ "NA",
        p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
        TRUE ~ as.character(signif(p, 2))
      ),
      label_text = paste0(SampleType, ": rho=", rho, ", p=", p_text)
    )

  overall_p_text <- case_when(
    overall_cor$p.value < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    TRUE ~ as.character(signif(overall_cor$p.value, 2))
  )

  subtitle_text <- paste0(
    "Overall: rho=",
    round(unname(overall_cor$estimate), 2),
    ", p=",
    overall_p_text
  )

  # Line breaks prevent clipping in combined panels
  caption_text <- paste(group_stats$label_text, collapse = "   |   ")
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Taxa_value, y = Behavior_value)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = SampleType),
      size = 4,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      color = "black",
      fill = "grey80",
      se = TRUE,
      linewidth = 1.1
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      aes(color = SampleType),
      method = "lm",
      se = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.9,
      linetype = "dotted"
    ) +
    scale_x_log10(
      labels = label_scientific(),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.10))
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 20),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.9, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "plain", size = 24, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 15, r = 15, b = 35, l = 35)
    ) +
  labs(
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      caption = caption_text,
      # FIX: Used atop() to handle multi-line math expression wrapping
      x = bquote(
        atop(italic(.(taxa_clean)), "relative abundance (log10 scale)")
      ),
      y = behavior_clean
    ) +
    # FIX: Cleaned up bquote syntax to evaluate character string correctly
    ggtitle(
      bquote(italic(.(taxa_clean)) ~ "vs" ~ .(as.character(behavior_clean)))
    )

  return(p)
}
```

#Spearman correlation between Control and Prenatal Exposure (ALC, CB, ALC+CB)

```{r}

# ==============================
# Output folder
# ==============================

exposure_scatter_dir <- file.path(
  outdir,
  "Genus_Species_CON_vs_PrenatalExposure_Scatterplots"
)

dir.create(exposure_scatter_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ==============================
# Use significant genus + species hits
# from previous volcano result table
# ==============================

sig_genus_species <- all_results_df %>%
  filter(
    Level %in% c("Genus", "Species"),
    Pvalue < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(Level, Pvalue)

write.csv(
  sig_genus_species,
  file.path(
    exposure_scatter_dir,
    "Significant_Genus_Species_Hits_For_CON_vs_Exposure.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

if(nrow(sig_genus_species) == 0){
  stop("No significant genus/species hits found at Pvalue < 0.05.")
}

# ==============================
# Settings
# ==============================

pseudocount <- 1e-6

group_colors <- c(
  "CON" = "#377EB8",
  "Prenatal Exposure" = "#E41A1C"
)

# ==============================
# Scatterplot function
# ==============================

make_exposure_scatter <- function(data, taxa_name, behavior_name, level_name){

  taxa_clean <- taxa_name %>%
    str_replace("^(g__|s__)", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("_", " ")

  # Safety check for behavior titles lookup
  behavior_clean <- behavior_titles[[behavior_name]]
  if (is.null(behavior_clean)) {
    behavior_clean <- behavior_name
  }

  plot_df <- data %>%
    mutate(
      Taxa_value = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(as.character(.data[[taxa_name]]))
      ) + pseudocount,

      Behavior_value = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(as.character(.data[[behavior_name]]))
      ),

      ExposureGroup = case_when(
  SampleType == "CON" ~ "CON",
  SampleType %in% c("ALC", "CB", "ALC+CB") ~ "Prenatal Exposure",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
),

ExposureGroup = factor(
  ExposureGroup,
  levels = c("CON", "Prenatal Exposure")
)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Taxa_value),
      !is.na(Behavior_value),
      Taxa_value > 0,
      !is.na(ExposureGroup)
    )

  overall_cor <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(
      plot_df$Taxa_value,
      plot_df$Behavior_value,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )

  group_stats <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(ExposureGroup) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      rho = ifelse(
        n >= 4 &&
          length(unique(Taxa_value)) > 1 &&
          length(unique(Behavior_value)) > 1,
        suppressWarnings(
          cor.test(
            Taxa_value,
            Behavior_value,
            method = "spearman",
            exact = FALSE
          )$estimate
        ),
        NA
      ),
      p = ifelse(
        n >= 4 &&
          length(unique(Taxa_value)) > 1 &&
          length(unique(Behavior_value)) > 1,
        suppressWarnings(
          cor.test(
            Taxa_value,
            Behavior_value,
            method = "spearman",
            exact = FALSE
          )$p.value
        ),
        NA
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      rho = round(rho, 2),
      p_text = case_when(
        is.na(p) ~ "NA",
        p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
        TRUE ~ as.character(signif(p, 2))
      ),
      label_text = paste0(
        ExposureGroup,
        ": rho=",
        rho,
        ", p=",
        p_text
      )
    )

  overall_p_text <- case_when(
    overall_cor$p.value < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    TRUE ~ as.character(signif(overall_cor$p.value, 2))
  )

  subtitle_text <- paste0(
    "Overall: rho=",
    round(unname(overall_cor$estimate), 2),
    ", p=",
    overall_p_text
  )

  caption_text <- paste(group_stats$label_text, collapse = "   |   ")

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = Taxa_value,
      y = Behavior_value
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = ExposureGroup),
      size = 4.2,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      color = "black",
      fill = "grey80",
      se = TRUE,
      linewidth = 1.1
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      aes(color = ExposureGroup),
      method = "lm",
      se = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.9,
      linetype = "dotted"
    ) +
    scale_x_log10(
      labels = label_scientific(),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.10))
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colors) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 24),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 20),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.9, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "plain", size = 24, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        size = 16,
        hjust = 0,
        face = "bold",
        color = "black"
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 15, r = 15, b = 25, l = 15)
    ) +
    labs(
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      caption = caption_text,
      # FIX: Used atop() to handle multi-line math expression wrapping
      x = bquote(
        atop(italic(.(taxa_clean)), "relative abundance (log10 scale)")
      ),
      y = behavior_clean
    ) +
    # FIX: Cleaned up bquote syntax to evaluate character string correctly
    ggtitle(
      bquote(italic(.(taxa_clean)) ~ "vs" ~ .(as.character(behavior_clean)))
    )

  return(p)
}

# ==============================
# Generate plots
# ==============================

exposure_plots <- list()

for(i in seq_len(nrow(sig_genus_species))){

  taxa_i <- sig_genus_species$Taxa[i]
  behavior_i <- sig_genus_species$Behavior[i]
  level_i <- sig_genus_species$Level[i]

  p_i <- make_exposure_scatter(
    data = df,
    taxa_name = taxa_i,
    behavior_name = behavior_i,
    level_name = level_i
  )

  exposure_plots[[i]] <- p_i

  print(p_i)

  safe_taxa <- taxa_i %>%
    str_replace("^(g__|s__)", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_")

  # Safety check fallback for ggsave naming
  b_title <- behavior_titles[[behavior_i]]
  if (is.null(b_title)) b_title <- behavior_i

  safe_behavior <- b_title %>%
    str_replace_all(" ", "_") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "")

  safe_level <- level_i

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      exposure_scatter_dir,
      paste0(
        safe_level,
        "_Scatter_",
        safe_taxa,
        "_",
        safe_behavior,
        "_CON_vs_PrenatalExposure.pdf"
      )
    ),
    p_i,
    width = 10,
    height = 7
  )
}

# ==============================
# Combined panel
# ==============================

if(length(exposure_plots) > 0){

  # FIX: Explicitly remove legends on elements before using common.legend
  plots_for_panel <- lapply(exposure_plots, function(p) {
    p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  })

  combined_exposure <- ggarrange(
    plotlist = plots_for_panel,
    ncol = 3,
    nrow = ceiling(length(plots_for_panel) / 3),
    common.legend = TRUE,
    legend = "right",
    legend.grob = get_legend(exposure_plots[[1]]) # Pulls crisp unified legend
  )

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      exposure_scatter_dir,
      "Combined_Genus_Species_CON_vs_PrenatalExposure_Scatterplots.pdf"
    ),
    combined_exposure,
    width = 22,
    height = ceiling(length(plots_for_panel) / 2) * 6
  )
}
```
